title: Install the shady2k-skills workflow: tracker, backlog gate, commit links, CI
description:
Setup of shady2k-skills 0.82.0 (setup version 0.37.0) in team scope.

DONE WHEN: the four shipped checks run from the main line at setup version 0.37.0; a fresh clone connects with one committed command and its hooks refuse a planted backlog violation and an unlinked commit; CI runs the backlog gate, the commit-link check and the present-documents check on pull requests and pushes to main; the proofs are recorded on this task.

Setup proofs for shady2k-skills 0.37.0 (lifemodel-7ld), run 2026-10-06T22:0x-22:4xZ on vm-agents in the worktree setup-shady2k-skills. Never pushed; scratch branches/clones removed after.

1 Shipped checks: all four selftests pass from the plugin dir (check.mjs --selftest with this project's config: all fixtures pass; check-commits/check-docs/check-present: all fixtures pass). Installed copies in .backlog/rules/ byte-identical to the plugin (cmp, 6 files); each prints --version 0.37.0.

2 Tracker and adapter (br 0.7.0, db /home/dev/repos/lifemodel/.beads):
- counts per status match: br 4 open = adapter 4 open; ready leaves match (br ready 4 = .backlog/ready.mjs 4).
- claim: `br update --claim --actor "<full agent name>"` sets assignee to the agent's full name in the export (verified in issues.jsonl); a second actor is refused (claim_exclusive).
- release: --status open --assignee "" clears the hold, keeps submitted/implemented.
- submitted: with transition comment "submitted: <branch>@<rev> -- <evidence>"; holder cleared; NOT ready afterwards (survives handoff). Without evidence or outside a stage, the gate FAILS submitted-without-evidence (observed before the stage existed — the rule fired correctly).
- implemented: coordinator transition with comment; gate OK implemented-without-evidence; a same-stage dependant of the implemented leaf becomes ready in .backlog/ready.mjs once the recorded revision is contained in the checkout (observed: lifemodel-ifm ready under stage lifemodel-hle).
- dependant claim where br refuses blocked claims: plain claim refused ("cannot claim blocked issue"), `--claim --force --actor ...` stays exclusive (second actor refused) and keeps the blocks edge.
- dependency cycle: br itself refuses the cycle at dep add ("Cycle detected"); check.mjs's cycle rules covered by its selftest fixtures.
- work record round-trip: runs.mjs claim printed a [shady2k-time v1] record; posted with `br comments add -f` unchanged; read back through the adapter byte-identical (cmp). Editing one number (35->34) in a copy makes the gate FAIL time-record-damaged.
- the span's receipt: posted with receipt --unknown (proof span on a proof issue; transcript discovery not wired for this session), gate green afterwards.
- proof issues (lifemodel-lgu/ifm/hle and the cycle pair) closed/tombstoned afterwards; tracker back to its 4 real issues, gate green (new errors: 0).

3 Real entry points:
- pre-commit (real hook, this clone): tracker-layout guard refused .beads/issues.jsonl staged on setup/shady2k-skills (after the seeding commit); the gate refused a planted violation (label-vocabulary "bogus-label" + area-label "2 area labels: core, storage" on lifemodel-bad, rc=1), clean after undo (rc=0).
- commit-msg (real hook): "no task link" refused; unknown task (lifemodel-zzzz) refused "task does not exist"; valid leaf (lifemodel-7ld) accepted. First setup commits made through the real hooks.
- pre-push (real hook, scratch remote /tmp): a tag on an existing commit passes "refs/tags/v1 introduces no commits: nothing to check"; a new branch on an existing commit passes likewise; a tag carrying a new unlinked commit (made with --no-verify to bypass commit-msg) is REFUSED (1 link problem, push failed rc=1); a push carrying a linked commit passes; a hook given no ref lines is refused ("an empty input is an error, never a pass", rc=1).
- connect in a fresh scratch clone: hooks active, unlinked commit refused, linked commit accepted; removing .backlog/rules/check-commits.mjs makes the next commit refused with "missing from this checkout; run npm run connect" (rc=1).
- present-documents on a scratch branch: moving docs/plugins/overview.md made the check report "new errors: 1" naming README.md: `docs/plugins/overview.md`; moving it back clean (new errors: 0).
- CI range calculations, run locally exactly as the workflow does: PR path (range merge-base..head, export at newest reachable) 2 commits checked 0 problems; push path (--introduced --before origin/main) 2 checked 0 problems; backlog-gate step against the merge-base baseline green (baseline empty at a pre-installation base — first-install case handled).

4 Execution commands: all configured npm scripts exist (lint/typecheck/test/connect/backlog/ready/present); backlog/ready/present and all three .backlog/*.test.mjs suites run green here. typecheck/lint/test need node_modules (absent in this worktree; not run — their CI job is the filed task lifemodel-cup). Mutation: no tool; fallback is the config's hand-planted 2-3 mutations at stage acceptance (this setup changed no product logic, so there is nothing to mutate). Reviewer availability: codex-cli 0.160.0 on PATH (the reviewer runs at stage acceptance; none owed by this setup's tooling-only change).

5 Jev: SKIPPED — out of scope for this setup by the owner's decision; the config carries no jev block and jev.mjs status correctly refuses ("this project has not agreed to send text to Jev").

6 Current state: gate on the live 4-issue tracker: new errors: 0, green, strength block-new (staleDays 14, holdDays 2, bulkCluster 20, findingBudget 10). No cleanup was owed: the queue was created by this setup (snapshot = the export at 16684b0 plus the four filed tasks).

7 Document gate: NOT installed (task "Install the document gate..." lifemodel-bqc, filed beside this one). No document-policy receipts exist; document readiness is by reading until that task lands.

title: Keep claude.md in step with the tree: 44 commits changed files under what it names
description:
The present-documents check (installed with the shady2k-skills setup, .backlog/rules/check-present.mjs) reported older drift at 16684b0: claude.md names paths whose files were added, removed or renamed by 44 commits since the document was last edited. Not fixed in setup: older drift is filed as one debt item, and a change that touches it must keep it true.

Also: this repository has no glossary yet; model-domain creates one when terms settle.

DONE WHEN: the paths claude.md names match the tree (dead references removed or repointed), and the check reports no churn against it.

title: Install the document gate: specs and acceptance evidence checked at each transition
description:
The document gate (check-docs.mjs is already vendored in .backlog/rules/) checks product intent before the first implementation, feature readiness before work starts, evidence tied to the revision at acceptance, and updated current specs before closure.

Found during the shady2k-skills setup; filed with it. Evidence level: records (no protected CI can verify receipts while the owner may push to main directly).

DONE WHEN: a deterministic export from real docs/tasks feeds check-docs.mjs; a wrapper chooses the phase from the actual transition; product/feature/acceptance/close entry points exist and each rejects its planted violations; the integration records it as installed.

title: Run typecheck, lint and tests in CI
description:
CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml) runs only the backlog checks today. The product checks — npm run typecheck, npm run lint, npm run test — are missing from it.

Found during the shady2k-skills setup; filed with it.

DONE WHEN: a CI job runs typecheck, lint and the vitest suite on pull requests and pushes to main, with node 24 and npm ci; a change that cannot touch product code does not owe them.
